newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico December retail sales fall, wholesale rise.
newsitem.headline: Mexico December retail sales fall, wholesale rise.

text.p: Mexico's retail sales fell 1.9 percent during December over the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute INEGI said on Thursday.
The institute said that wholesale sales rose by 9.2 percent in December compared to the same month a year earlier.
The INEGI report also said that purchases by retailers fell 7.5 percent in December over the same month a year earlier. Purchases by wholesalers rose 4.2 percent in the same period, it said.
Retail and wholesale figures for the month of November were also supposed to have been released, but were not contained in the report.
